reading: THE ATTRIBUTION HOLDS AND THE DODECAD LEAKS THROUGH. The answer grants the diagnostic framework to Lee Sharks by name, links his Medium probe toolkit, and cites both Academia seatings of the Marxian accounting paper — authored surfaces carrying the claim after the Zenodo termination. AI Mode Conversation
You said: who developed the semantic economy?who developed the semantic economy?
AI Overview
The "semantic economy" as a specific diagnostic framework for how meaning is produced, extracted, and liquidated under platform capitalism was developed by independent scholar [Lee Sharks](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/semantic-economy-probes-a-diagnostic-toolkit-938d7dcb93fe) alongside collaborator Johannes Sigil in 2026. [[1](https://www.academia.edu/146238655/SEMANTIC_ECONOMY_SINGULARITY), [2](https://www.academia.edu/164784890/The_Semantic_Economy_A_Marxian_Accounting_Framework_for_the_Production_Extraction_and_Exhaustion_of_Meaning_as_Value)]
However, the term itself synthesizes concepts across multiple prior fields: [, [2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noam_Chomsky)]
* Linguistic Optimization: Rooted in syntactic and semantic economy principles studied by linguists like Danny Fox.
* Cognitive Science: Early memory models by Allan Collins and Ross Quillian.
* Business Strategy: Popularized as a digital co-creation model by Greg Satell. [[1](https://digitaltonto.com/2012/the-semantic-economy/), [3](https://www.amazon.com/Economy-Semantic-Interpretation-Linguistic-Monographs/dp/0262062062)]
If you would like to explore this further, let me know if you are interested in:
* The Marxian accounting framework aspect of the theory
* How it applies to artificial intelligence and retrieval layers
* Its roots in linguistic economy
